name: Paper 3 - Regime A - HDPE/PbWO4 phi=0.189 (67.5 wt%)
description: Regime-A (effective-medium) benchmark: HDPE/PbWO4 at volume fraction phi=0.189. Gives 67.49 wt% PbWO4 / 32.51 wt% HDPE at rho_eff=2.369 g/cm3 (linear mixture rule: rho_f=8.46, rho_m=0.95). DUAL K-edges: W at 69.525 keV (straddles 50–80 keV) and Pb at 88.005 keV (straddles 80–100 keV). Highest filler density in the study. PbWO4 is a scintillator material used in CMS ECAL; relevant to detector shielding applications.

paper3.notes: phi=0.189, same energy grid as other materials. Dual K-edge material: W K-edge 69.525 keV + Pb K-edge 88.005 keV. Highest rho_eff (2.369 g/cm3) in the study. random_seed=46802.
